mapper.select: SELECT ps.SUBSCRIPTION_NO, ps.MEMBER_NO, ps.PRODUCT_NO, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRODUCT_TYPE, p.INTEREST_PAYMENT_TYPE, p.INTEREST_CALC_TYPE, ps.JOIN_CHANNEL, ps.APPLIED_INTEREST_RATE, ps.SUBSCRIPTION_MONTHS, ps.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT, ps.AUTO_TRANSFER_AMOUNT, ps.LINKED_ACCOUNT_NO, ps.SUBSCRIBED_AT, ps.MATURITY_DATE, ps.SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, TRUNC(ps.MATURITY_DATE) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS REMAINING_DAYS FROM TB_PRODUCT_SALES ps JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON ps.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO WHERE ps.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY ps.SUBSCRIBED_AT DESC

SELECT ps.SUBSCRIPTION_NO, ps.MEMBER_NO, ps.PRODUCT_NO, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRODUCT_TYPE, p.MIN_INTEREST_RATE, p.MAX_INTEREST_RATE, p.INTEREST_PAYMENT_TYPE, p.INTEREST_CALC_TYPE, ps.JOIN_CHANNEL, ps.APPLIED_INTEREST_RATE, ps.SUBSCRIPTION_MONTHS, ps.SUBSCRIPTION_AMOUNT, ps.AUTO_TRANSFER_AMOUNT, ps.LINKED_ACCOUNT_NO, ps.SUBSCRIBED_AT, ps.MATURITY_DATE, ps.SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, TRUNC(ps.MATURITY_DATE) - TRUNC(SYSDATE) AS REMAINING_DAYS FROM TB_PRODUCT_SALES ps JOIN TB_PRODUCT p ON ps.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO WHERE ps.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND ps.SUBSCRIPTION_NO = #{subscriptionNo}
